reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates pass. Gate 1: syncAllRoles is registered as a live POST route in src/index.ts:69 with confirmed callers. Gate 2: no trust_assumptions table in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json; entry point is the authenticated REST API (no trusted-source exemption applies). Gate 3: finding targets src/api/rolesSyncAll.ts (explicitly in scope); BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json lists 'Discord API rate limiting not implemented in bulk sync' as a recognized key security concern. Code confirms sequential awaited Discord REST calls (getMember + role ops) inside an unbounded for...of loop with no semaphore, sleep, or queue cap. Attack path requires possession of API_AUTH_TOKEN, making exploitability uncertain — hence CONFIRMED_POTENTIAL over CONFIRMED_VULNERABILITY. Severity remains Medium: resource exhaustion / bot degradation, no client_diversity cap applicable.
